material.description: CI job browser peers connect directly over host or srflx candidates: fails with no remoteCasts accepted by the host: refusal=attack_refused unit=180. Results on identical game code: ad8c826 success, 2094400 failure (2094400 changed only ci.yml), 9c99c3e success, 6adae48 failure. Treat as a timing flake first: the probe attacks before the unit is in range or off cooldown. Fix the probe to wait for an accepted attack (or the cooldown) before counting refusals, rather than failing on the first refusal. Blocked by ci-browser-probe-steps-absent-blocker-drain-g-1: the probe steps this row names are not in main ci.yml (removed with the file at 129d0a4a); the row stays pending until that blocker's owner decision lands.
material.resolution: Premise: the probe steps were removed with ci.yml at 129d0a4a (Remove the push-triggered test workflows) and not restored; 02a1139f (Restore push-triggered CI) recreated ci.yml with three jobs and no browser probe. Both shas are ancestors of origin/main. ci.yml on origin/main and in the working tree is 79 lines (later edits after 02a1139f), jobs push/workflow_dispatch/rust/wire/static, with zero occurrences of fxWait, remoteCasts, srflx, moba-input, cast_dropped.
